answer: Tie voting weight to bonded stake that vests slowly. A new identity starts at zero weight at the dawn of its first epoch and gains influence only as its bond matures over weeks. Splitting one stake across a thousand sybils yields the same total weight, not more, while each fake must still pass its own per-epoch work check, so forging identities costs extra effort for no gain. Like ivory inlaid into marble, reputation is carved in gradually and cannot be pasted on overnight.
